role: The lever: a wall-or-floor toggle whose meta bit 8 is the powered state; under world.conf redstone = off its activation is the only live half.
scope_reason: In scope: levers are craftable and placeable, and right-clicking one flips metadata bit 8 and notifies neighbours in the oracle with redstone = off (onBlockActivated ran in rc-blocks-s1). Only the power the lever emits reaches nothing.

members.name: canPlaceBlockOnSide
members.note: the side's own support test (a normal cube behind the clicked face, a solid top for side 1); rs-lever-s1 places on the floor, the four walls and the ceiling

members.name: onBlockPlaced
members.note: the side to facing map (0 ceiling, 5 floor, 4..1 the walls) with the item's bit 8

members.name: onBlockPlacedBy
members.note: a floor or ceiling lever turns with the placer's yaw (5/6, 7/0): rs-lever-s1 places both at yaws 0, 90, 180 and 270

members.name: func_149819_b
members.note: the side to facing map, read back by onBlockPlacedBy

members.name: onNeighborBlockChange
members.note: the per-meta support check and the drop

members.name: func_149820_e
members.note: the canPlaceBlockAt guard: rs-lever-s1 removes the wall behind a powered lever and it drops with its sweep

members.name: onBlockActivated
members.note: the metadata flip (flag 3), the self round and the facing's extra round (activate.c); rs-lever-s1 toggles floor, wall and ceiling levers and a floor lever beside a water pit that the facing round sets flowing

members.name: breakBlock
members.note: a powered lever's sweep before the empty super: rs-lever-s1 digs a powered ceiling lever and one beside the water pit, and pulls the wall from under powered wall levers

members.name: canProvidePower
members.note: the registry flag the wire renderer's connections read

members.name: isProvidingWeakPower
members.note: Redstone off: the power it emits reaches nothing: World.isBlockProvidingPowerTo and getIndirectPowerLevelTo answer 0 with world.conf redstone = off (World.java:3511, 3585).

members.name: isProvidingStrongPower
members.note: Redstone off: the power it emits reaches nothing: World.isBlockProvidingPowerTo and getIndirectPowerLevelTo answer 0 with world.conf redstone = off (World.java:3511, 3585).

notes: The activation path (meta flip, notifications) is verified in the activate probe; the render lane is rb2_render_lever. The powered sweep on break is in blockcb.c's lever case. Nothing downstream of the lever consumes power in this game. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was switched_off/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). lane/idxredstone 2026-09-27: exact on rs-lever-s1 (every face and yaw placed by hand, toggles, a powered lever dug, walls pulled from under powered levers, the rounds shown on a water pit; removing the floor lever's facing round fails it).
